mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_id, user_name, user_email, user_password, user_token, user_number) VALUES (null,#{user_name},#{user_email},#{user_password},null,#{user_number})
INSERT INTO user_information (user_id, user_nick_name, user_gender, user_birthday, user_personalized_signature, user_profile_picture) VALUES (#{user_id},null,null,null,null,null)
mapper.select: SELECT users.user_id, users.user_name, users.user_email, users.user_token, users.user_number, role_user.role_id FROM users LEFT JOIN role_user ON users.user_id = role_user.user_id ORDER BY users.user_id
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_number = #{user_number}

SELECT DISTINCT users.user_id,user_name,role_name FROM users LEFT JOIN role_user ON users.user_id = role_user.user_id LEFT JOIN roles ON roles.role_id = role_user.role_id WHERE role_name = '教师' OR role_name = '班主任'
